newsitem.title: USA: USDA to grant pork virus patent.
newsitem.headline: USDA to grant pork virus patent.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department said Thursday it planned to grant an exclusive license to NOBL Laboratories Inc for a procedure to differentiate among pork virus strains.
In a notice published in the Federal Register, the agency's Agricultural Research Service said it planned to grant the license for NOBL's patent application filed on March 1, 1996.
The agency said it would accept public comments on the plan until June 30.
The royalty-bearing patent is entitled "Restriction Enzyme Screen for Differentiating Porcine Reproductive and Respiratory Syndrome Virus Strains."
